summary: Sam Forstag stated he would not vote for an appropriations package sending weapons to Israel, calling the situation in Gaza 'a genocide.'
quote: No. I would not vote for that (sending weapons to Israel)… I would not vote for an appropriations package that is sending American weapons to fund, I don't see other term for it than a genocide, that's going on in Gaza.
